_readme: Manual corrections applied on top of the official GTFS feed every time the pipeline runs (python3 gtfs-raw/build_data.py). Your fixes here survive future GTFS re-imports — never edit src/data/tirana-bus-data.ts by hand, it gets overwritten.
_howToFindAGtfsStopId: Open gtfs-raw/bus-routes.json after a build and search for the wrong stop by name — each stop entry has a 'gtfsStopId' field. Use that value as the key in moveStops/renameStops/hideStops below.
_hideStops_example: hideStops: [ "<gtfsStopId>", ... ] -- completely removes a stop that shouldn't exist
_addStops_example: addStops: [ { "routeId": "1A" (the route's visible short name), "direction": "fwd" or "return", "name": "New Stop", "lat": 41.3275, "lng": 19.8187 } ] -- for a real-world stop the municipality's feed is missing entirely
